//Fido2: WebAuthn / passkey Relying Party for account (device) passkeys. ServerDomain MUST be the RP host the clients use and the host that serves /.well-known/assetlinks.json (Android) + /apple-app-site-association (iOS) - that is the web app domain, shared by web AND native mobile so one passkey identity covers all. Origins must list the web origin(s). Local dev overrides this to localhost in appsettings.Development.json.
//ConnectionStrings: Set the real production connection string on the server — do NOT commit real credentials. Use the SmarterASP control panel or the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable in web.config; the values below are placeholders only. The provider selected by 'DatabaseProvider' picks the matching entry: Sqlite→SqliteConnection, Sqlserver→DefaultConnection, Postgres→PostgresConnection, Mysql→MySqlConnection.
//DatabaseProvider: Production runs on SQL Server. Set the real connection string in ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection on the server (the value above is only an offline placeholder). Local development overrides this to 'Sqlite' in appsettings.Development.json so the API runs with no cloud/SQL dependency.
//UseSharedMachineDatabase: When true, the API adopts the DatabaseProvider + SqliteDatabasePath written to %LocalAppData%\VaultGuard\settings.json by the WPF/Web apps so all VaultGuard apps on one machine share a vault. Leave false for server deployments.

//Sso: SSO provider list surfaced via GET /api/sso/providers, and used by the AspNetUserLogins link-management endpoints (see SsoController.cs). The API doesn't run the OIDC challenge itself - only Id/DisplayName are ever returned to clients. Keep this list's Ids in sync with VaultGuard.Web's and VaultGuard.WPF's Sso:Providers so 'google'/'keycloak'/etc. mean the same provider everywhere. See docs/SSO.md.
